title: Men’s 400m Hurdles World Rankings, November 2026
desc: The ten highest-ranked athletes in the World Athletics men’s 400m hurdles event group on 10 November 2026, by ranking points. AllRanks displays a shared fifth place for Emil Agyekum and Ezekiel Nathaniel. World Athletics lists them fifth and sixth.

source.name: World Athletics — Men’s 400m Hurdles World Rankings
source.note: The AllRanks assistant (Codex) verified all ten athletes, federation codes, places and ranking points against the official 10 November 2026 edition on 19 November 2026 (Korea time). This snapshot covers places 1–10. Tenth place scored 1,318 points and eleventh scored 1,315. The official event group includes eligible 300m hurdles performances. The two athletes on 1,387 points appear in source order.
